title: The Three Senses Alerting Standard
description: Open rules that make every emergency warning readable by sight, touch, or hearing alone. The repository holds the specification (CC BY-ND 4.0), the normative machine-readable rhythm vocabulary, conformance requirements R1 to R8 with a runnable validator, and the @ideafe/three-senses TypeScript SDK (Apache-2.0). Published by International Deaf Emergency, a Deaf-led US 501(c)(3) nonprofit. See it. Feel it. Hear it.
